name: Easily confused words
note: Pairs that learners mix up: make/do, say/tell, borrow/lend, bring/take, as/like, lie/lay, its/it's, been/gone. Check the exact pattern each one needs.

questions.q: His mother forced him to ______ his homework every night after supper.
questions.fs: His mother forced him to do his homework every night after supper.

questions.q: All children love to open ______ on Christmas morning.
questions.fs: All children love to open presents on Christmas morning.

questions.q: I'm not quite ready yet?? I have to ______ my hair.
questions.fs: I'm not quite ready yet?? I have to do my hair.

questions.q: The gang didn't like Simon, so after school they confronted him and ______ him up.
questions.fs: The gang didn't like Simon, so after school they confronted him and beat him up.

questions.q: His teacher begged him to ______ more of an effort in class.
questions.fs: His teacher begged him to make more of an effort in class.

questions.q: After the huge feast, Tim's stomach ached because he ______ so much delicious food at one time.
questions.fs: After the huge feast, Tim's stomach ached because he ate so much delicious food at one time.

questions.q: The business ______ a lot of money this year.
questions.fs: The business made a lot of money this year.

questions.q: The painting had beautiful colors in it, but the content was a little ______
questions.fs: The painting had beautiful colors in it, but the content was a little odd.

questions.q: The university research team stumbled upon something; it ______ a really big discovery.
questions.fs: The university research team stumbled upon something; it made a really big discovery.

questions.q: Wild ______ are native across much of Central Europe, the Mediterranean Region and much of Asia as far south as Indonesia, and have been introduced elsewhere.
questions.fs: Wild boars are native across much of Central Europe, the Mediterranean Region and much of Asia as far south as Indonesia, and have been introduced elsewhere.

questions.q: He was confused and couldn't ______ up his mind about what to do next.
questions.fs: He was confused and couldn't make up his mind about what to do next.

questions.q: There are many ______ and unfortunate people in every country around the world.
questions.fs: There are many poor and unfortunate people in every country around the world.

questions.q: No matter how hard she pushed him, she couldn't ______ her son do the job properly.
questions.fs: No matter how hard she pushed him, she couldn't make her son do the job properly.

questions.q: The warm breeze and starry sky made that particular ______ the perfect setting for a romantic dinner.
questions.fs: The warm breeze and starry sky made that particular night the perfect setting for a romantic dinner.

questions.q: The teacher suggested they ______ another exercise to understand the problem better.
questions.fs: The teacher suggested they do another exercise to understand the problem better.

questions.q: For Christians around the world, Sunday is a ______ day. In the past, many people didn't work on Sundays. Nowadays, however, a lot of people do.
questions.fs: For Christians around the world, Sunday is a holy day. In the past, many people didn't work on Sundays. Nowadays, however, a lot of people do.

questions.q: We had so much fun in Chicago?? we ______ it in three days.
questions.fs: We had so much fun in Chicago?? we did it in three days.

questions.q: Casey asked her mother to ______ her a mountain bike for her 14th birthday next month.
questions.fs: Casey asked her mother to buy her a mountain bike for her 14th birthday next month.

questions.q: They ______ up quickly after their silly argument.
questions.fs: They made up quickly after their silly argument.

questions.q: The flight attendant walked up and down the ______ to make sure all of the passengers had enough to eat and drink on the long flight to Australia.
questions.fs: The flight attendant walked up and down the aisle to make sure all of the passengers had enough to eat and drink on the long flight to Australia.

questions.q: She ______ him a solemn promise that she would never steal again.
questions.fs: She made him a solemn promise that she would never steal again.

questions.q: I can ______ the Pacific Ocean and many marine animals, such as seagulls and porpoises, from my bedroom window every day.
questions.fs: I can see the Pacific Ocean and many marine animals, such as seagulls and porpoises, from my bedroom window every day.

questions.q: The teacher had to ______ up a new syllabus because her old one was outdated.
questions.fs: The teacher had to make up a new syllabus because her old one was outdated.

questions.q: The ______ on the little boy's bicycle needs to be replaced so he can safely ride his bike around the neighborhood.
questions.fs: The pedal on the little boy's bicycle needs to be replaced so he can safely ride his bike around the neighborhood.

questions.q: No one knows why he ______ those terrible things in the past.
questions.fs: No one knows why he did those terrible things in the past.

questions.q: The garden table was made of black ______ iron. It looks great with the other outdoor furniture on the patio.
questions.fs: The garden table was made of black wrought iron. It looks great with the other outdoor furniture on the patio.

questions.q: She finally begged him to ______ a move in their very long and tiresome chess game.
questions.fs: She finally begged him to make a move in their very long and tiresome chess game.

questions.q: After the lay-off announcement, most of the workers were in a ______ They couldn't believe they had all lost their jobs.
questions.fs: After the lay-off announcement, most of the workers were in a daze. They couldn't believe they had all lost their jobs.

questions.q: She suddenly realized that she only had a few days left on her vacation, so she decided to ______ the most of it.
questions.fs: She suddenly realized that she only had a few days left on her vacation, so she decided to make the most of it.

questions.q: At the office, the telephone must ______ four times before the answering machine picks up the call.
questions.fs: At the office, the telephone must ring four times before the answering machine picks up the call.

questions.q: He was very proud of his car yesterday, because during the race it ______ 260 km/hr.
questions.fs: He was very proud of his car yesterday, because during the race it did 260 km/hr.

questions.q: Tyler ______ that the team was in trouble, so he tried harder than usual to strike out the batter.
questions.fs: Tyler knew that the team was in trouble, so he tried harder than usual to strike out the batter.

questions.q: The manager was surprised at how many things Ron could ______ at once.
questions.fs: The manager was surprised at how many things Ron could do at once.

questions.q: The personnel department has interviewed many possible candidates for the job. They want to ______ someone by the end of the month.
questions.fs: The personnel department has interviewed many possible candidates for the job. They want to hire someone by the end of the month.

questions.q: Even though the situation was not ideal, they decided to ______ a go of things.
questions.fs: Even though the situation was not ideal, they decided to make a go of things.

questions.q: There is a great deli around the corner. Tom orders corned beef on ______ bread for lunch every day.
questions.fs: There is a great deli around the corner. Tom orders corned beef on rye bread for lunch every day.

questions.q: His mother was late because she ______ the beds before she left the house.
questions.fs: His mother was late because she made the beds before she left the house.

questions.q: Carson felt ______ and nauseous. He wondered if he'd gotten food poisoning from the seafood restaurant he'd dined in earlier in the evening.
questions.fs: Carson felt weak and nauseous. He wondered if he'd gotten food poisoning from the seafood restaurant he'd dined in earlier in the evening.

questions.q: We only have one more pot of stew?? will it ______ ?
questions.fs: We only have one more pot of stew?? will it do?

questions.q: Lance drew up the blueprints. He decided that the house would be about 1500 square ______ when construction was complete.
questions.fs: Lance drew up the blueprints. He decided that the house would be about 1500 square feet when construction was complete.

questions.q: You will need a passport if you want to cross the ______ They just changed the law this year.
questions.fs: You will need a passport if you want to cross the border. They just changed the law this year.

questions.q: There was a huge thunderstorm in the Midwest last week. ______ as big as baseballs fell from the sky and damaged many vehicles and homes.
questions.fs: There was a huge thunderstorm in the Midwest last week. Hailstones as big as baseballs fell from the sky and damaged many vehicles and homes.

questions.q: In Canada, there are many different types of wild animals, including large mammals such as ______
questions.fs: In Canada, there are many different types of wild animals, including large mammals such as moose.

questions.q: I pulled the plant out of the garden because I thought it was only a ______ It turns out it was an herb that I could have used in my cooking.
questions.fs: I pulled the plant out of the garden because I thought it was only a weed. It turns out it was an herb that I could have used in my cooking.

questions.q: ______ that, they were also happy about the purchase of their new home.
questions.fs: Besides that, they were also happy about the purchase of their new home.

questions.q: To improve Taylor's reading skills, his teacher told his mother that he should read his English assignments ______ at home every night.
questions.fs: To improve Taylor's reading skills, his teacher told his mother that he should read his English assignments aloud at home every night.

questions.q: The farmer often says that a peaceful, natural life is the only ______ for him.
questions.fs: The farmer often says that a peaceful, natural life is the only way for him.

questions.q: The army was led by a famous general ______ was known for his tactical and strategic raids.
questions.fs: The army was led by a famous general who was known for his tactical and strategic raids.

questions.q: Paul loves to hike early in the morning because everything is so crisp and fresh at that time. The morning dew and ______ makes the world look dreamy.
questions.fs: Paul loves to hike early in the morning because everything is so crisp and fresh at that time. The morning dew and mist makes the world look dreamy.

questions.q: The house is very large,and the most impressive part of it is the vaulted ______
questions.fs: The house is very large,and the most impressive part of it is the vaulted ceiling.

questions.q: Thomas went to church yesterday and met a really nice ______
questions.fs: Thomas went to church yesterday and met a really nice nun.

questions.q: I want you to ______ the restaurant tonight. I always decide and I'm tired of trying to find new and interesting places to eat.
questions.fs: I want you to choose the restaurant tonight. I always decide and I'm tired of trying to find new and interesting places to eat.

questions.q: The Sahara ______ is a very hot and dry place. However, in spite of the harsh climate, certain plants and animals continue to prosper there.
questions.fs: The Sahara Desert is a very hot and dry place. However, in spite of the harsh climate, certain plants and animals continue to prosper there.

questions.q: The successful advertising company is not really worried about ______ this fiscal year because they are doing so well.
questions.fs: The successful advertising company is not really worried about profits this fiscal year because they are doing so well.

questions.q: The ______ is large and has a Victorian flavor to it. We stayed there for two days.
questions.fs: The inn is large and has a Victorian flavor to it. We stayed there for two days.

questions.q: Carrie was tired and soon became ______ with the activity her teacher had assigned.
questions.fs: Carrie was tired and soon became bored with the activity her teacher had assigned.

questions.q: As the chocolate chip cookies baked in the oven, a delicious ______ filled the entire house.
questions.fs: As the chocolate chip cookies baked in the oven, a delicious scent filled the entire house.

questions.q: The farmer frantically called the veterinarian when he realized his cows broke into the grain ______ His whole herd could die because too much grain at one time is bad for cows.
questions.fs: The farmer frantically called the veterinarian when he realized his cows broke into the grain bin. His whole herd could die because too much grain at one time is bad for cows.

questions.q: She sewed a strong ______ to finish off the dress she was making for her granddaughter's birthday.
questions.fs: She sewed a strong seam to finish off the dress she was making for her granddaughter's birthday.

questions.q: There are also wild feline creatures such as cougars and ______
questions.fs: There are also wild feline creatures such as cougars and lynx.

questions.q: After retirement, the elderly couple decided it was time to ______ their large home and move into something smaller.
questions.fs: After retirement, the elderly couple decided it was time to sell their large home and move into something smaller.

questions.q: George ______ her on her speech and she politely thanked him as she walked past the crowd of reporters.
questions.fs: George complimented her on her speech and she politely thanked him as she walked past the crowd of reporters.

questions.q: The heavy rain fell hard against the window ______ all day long. By nightfall, the streets and sewers were overflowing with excess water.
questions.fs: The heavy rain fell hard against the window panes all day long. By nightfall, the streets and sewers were overflowing with excess water.

questions.q: Thomas doesn't like a lot of seafood. For example, he doesn't like clams, shrimp or ______
questions.fs: Thomas doesn't like a lot of seafood. For example, he doesn't like clams, shrimp or mussels.

questions.q: Kevin's dream of creating a perfect world is only an ______ because there is no such thing as a perfect world.
questions.fs: Kevin's dream of creating a perfect world is only an illusion because there is no such thing as a perfect world.

questions.q: Scientists have uncovered many of the mysteries regarding DNA strands and ______
questions.fs: Scientists have uncovered many of the mysteries regarding DNA strands and genes.

questions.q: The ______ point is that you'll have to seek counsel about the crisis you're facing.
questions.fs: The principal point is that you'll have to seek counsel about the crisis you're facing.

questions.q: Raymond is a mathematician. He just ______ an award for his work in the field of quantum physics.
questions.fs: Raymond is a mathematician. He just won an award for his work in the field of quantum physics.

questions.q: During the boring play, Isaiah began to ______ off. His head fell onto his mother's shoulder.
questions.fs: During the boring play, Isaiah began to doze off. His head fell onto his mother's shoulder.

questions.q: ______ is used as a main ingredient in many baked products.
questions.fs: Flour is used as a main ingredient in many baked products.

questions.q: The little ______ loves to horse around and play in the backyard with his dog, Skippy.
questions.fs: The little boy loves to horse around and play in the backyard with his dog, Skippy.

questions.q: The little girl ______ when her mother told her she couldn't have the toy she saw in the department store.
questions.fs: The little girl bawled when her mother told her she couldn't have the toy she saw in the department store.

questions.q: The Johnsons live very close to the ocean, and their three daughters love to go to the ______ in the summer. They look forward to it every year.
questions.fs: The Johnsons live very close to the ocean, and their three daughters love to go to the beach in the summer. They look forward to it every year.

questions.q: Sandra loves her drama class, so she decided to audition for the lead ______ in the school play.
questions.fs: Sandra loves her drama class, so she decided to audition for the lead role in the school play.

questions.q: First, Mandy said she wanted ______ pieces of candy, and then she asked for three.
questions.fs: First, Mandy said she wanted two pieces of candy, and then she asked for three.

questions.q: You must ______ the garlic cloves in order to use them in this recipe.
questions.fs: You must mince the garlic cloves in order to use them in this recipe.

questions.q: The World War was devastating ______ many countries.
questions.fs: The World War was devastating for many countries.

questions.q: Laurie loves trips to the ocean because she gets to swim in the sea and watch the ______ come in every evening.
questions.fs: Laurie loves trips to the ocean because she gets to swim in the sea and watch the tide come in every evening.

questions.q: You have to ______ a coat today because it's been snowing all night long. It's so cold!
questions.fs: You have to wear a coat today because it's been snowing all night long. It's so cold!

questions.q: I have to buy a ______ because I want to grow a productive vegetable garden this spring.
questions.fs: I have to buy a spade because I want to grow a productive vegetable garden this spring.

questions.q: Ms Simpson ______ the lesson on geometry yesterday, so you need to get the notes from one of your classmates as soon as possible.
questions.fs: Ms Simpson taught the lesson on geometry yesterday, so you need to get the notes from one of your classmates as soon as possible.

questions.q: Every night after supper, Lawrence lies down on the sofa with a good book. Lawrence needs a magnifying glass to read because his ______ is so bad.
questions.fs: Every night after supper, Lawrence lies down on the sofa with a good book. Lawrence needs a magnifying glass to read because his sight is so bad.

questions.q: The raccoon ______ the little squirrel around the backyard for nearly 20 minutes.
questions.fs: The raccoon chased the little squirrel around the backyard for nearly 20 minutes.

questions.q: A jogger immediately called the wildlife department on her cell phone when she saw the beached ______
questions.fs: A jogger immediately called the wildlife department on her cell phone when she saw the beached whale.

questions.q: Dorothy carefully ______ all of the Christmas gifts, and then she filled all of the stockings with small gifts and goodies.
questions.fs: Dorothy carefully wrapped all of the Christmas gifts, and then she filled all of the stockings with small gifts and goodies.

questions.q: The couple decided to go with the larger ______ because they are going to have about 250 guests attending their wedding reception in June.
questions.fs: The couple decided to go with the larger hall because they are going to have about 250 guests attending their wedding reception in June.

questions.q: Cindy realized the ______ was crisp and clean, and she breathed in deeply to soak up the night's natural charm.
questions.fs: Cindy realized the air was crisp and clean, and she breathed in deeply to soak up the night's natural charm.

questions.q: ______ are part of the elk, caribou and moose family.
questions.fs: Deer are part of the elk, caribou and moose family.

questions.q: Jeffrey decided to take some night classes. He really enjoys the first-year English ______ he attends every Tuesday and Thursday evening at the college.
questions.fs: Jeffrey decided to take some night classes. He really enjoys the first-year English course he attends every Tuesday and Thursday evening at the college.

questions.q: I asked my husband to ______ my purse while I put on my winter coat.
questions.fs: I asked my husband to hold my purse while I put on my winter coat.
